# WorkMate AI

> An AI productivity suite for the everyday workplace — draft emails, summarize meetings, plan your day, and chat with a workplace assistant.

WorkMate AI bundles four focused tools behind a single workspace, each tuned with engineered system prompts to produce ready-to-use, structured output.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the WorkMate AI suite.
- [Smart Email Generator](/email): Draft professional emails in any tone for clients, managers, or teammates.
- [Meeting Notes Summarizer](/meeting): Turn raw notes into decisions, action items, and deadlines.
- [AI Task Planner](/planner): Prioritized daily or weekly plans with realistic focus blocks.
- [Workplace Chatbot](/chat): Interactive assistant for workplace questions and brainstorming.
- [Guide: How to automate workplace tasks with AI](/blog/how-to-automate-workplace-tasks): Practical playbook for using AI tools to take over routine email, meetings, and planning.
